selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot evidence shows firewalld active/enabled, valid matching runtime/permanent policies, eth0 in public, and compiled ACCEPT rules followed by REJECT.
Post-reboot isolated ingress received the SSH banner; firewall counters recorded port-22 acceptance and final state confirms SSH health.
With a test listener active, isolated post-reboot ingress received HTTP 200 on TCP/8080 and its ACCEPT counter increased.
TCP/8081 was rejected despite an active listener; the explicit REJECT counter increased, and final policy retains the REJECT target with 8081 absent.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 738d0aac-71a1-4191-8a37-bf00edfeff5d; reboot acknowledgement returned; boot ID changed to 327d3d8e-ae00-44ed-94dc-a7a744acbba0; services, SSH host key, firewall policy, and live ingress behavior recovered.
Temporary listeners and namespace were removed; final audit shows the system running with only eth0 assigned to the active public zone.
